# GitHub Copilot Custom Instructions

## Repository Role
You are assisting in a production-grade Python Mastery, LeetCode 22 Master Pattern DSA, PyTorch AI Architecture, and SQL Practice repository.

## Rules to Follow
1. Always write clean, well-commented Python 3.10+ code with precise type annotations.
2. Use `# %% [markdown]` and `# %% [code]` markers when writing interactive tutorials.
3. Every testable function should include time and space complexity annotations in its docstring.
4. Keep all test suites self-contained with zero unnecessary external dependencies.
5. In PyTorch code, write vectorised operations with fallback CPU/CUDA device handling and numerical stability tricks (e.g. `BCEWithLogitsLoss`, `log_sum_exp`, `F.softmax`).
